mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which can stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher during housing market expansion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower during economic slowdowns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when both proxies increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) signals tight monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a tightening cycle may lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower during tightening cycles (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) may lead to interest rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
